description: This PHP source file defines a Doctrine ORM utility class for managing database entity interactions, configuration, and connection setup in the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration initialization, entity manager singleton pattern, and cache setup.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the Doctrine ORM EntityManager configuration and access, including setting up cache and custom functions based on environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Doctrine configuration, including cache, proxies, and database connection based on system configuration.

methods.name: isDevMode
methods.description: Determines if the system is running in development mode by checking the kernel's debug status.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves entity mapping paths from plugin directories based on configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Implements singleton pattern to instantiate and access the Doctrine utility.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Provides access to the Doctrine ORM EntityManager instance.
